title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an External… (CVE-2026-80499)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have an External Control of File Name or Path vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially gain unauthorized access by manipulating file names or paths. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.1, indicating a medium severity level.
